arxiv-2110-07673.title: A hyperplane restriction theorem for holomorphic mappings and its application for the gap conjecture
arxiv-2110-07673.creator: Yun Gao, Sui-Chung Ng
arxiv-2110-07673.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yun Gao, Sui-Chung Ng. We established a hyperplane restriction theorem for the local holomorphic mappings between projective spaces, which is inspired by the corresponding theorem of Green for 𝒪 ℙ n ​ ( d ) \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^{n}}(d) . Our theorem allows us to give the first proof for the existence of gaps (albeit smaller) at all levels for the rational proper maps between complex unit balls, conjectured by Huang-Ji-Yin.

arxiv-2408-00410.title: Synchrotron x-ray diffraction and DFT study of non-centrosymmetric EuRhGe 3 under high pressure
arxiv-2408-00410.creator: N. S. Dhami, V. Balédent, I. Batistić, O. Bednarchuk, D. Kaczorowski, J. P. Itié, S. R. Shieh, C. M. N. Kumar, Y. Utsumi
arxiv-2408-00410.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by N. S. Dhami, V. Balédent, I. Batistić, O. Bednarchuk, D. Kaczorowski, J. P. Itié, S. R. Shieh, C. M. N. Kumar, Y. Utsumi. Antiferromagnetic intermetallic compound EuRhGe 3 crystalizes in a non-centrosymmetric BaNiSn 3 -type ( I ​ 4 ​ m ​ m I4mm ) structure. We studied its pressure-dependent crystal structure by using synchrotron powder x-ray diffraction at room temperature.

arxiv-2412-00572.title: On Nearly Optimal Paper Moebius Bands
arxiv-2412-00572.creator: Richard Evan Schwartz
arxiv-2412-00572.description: Abstract Let ϵ < 1 / 384 \epsilon<1/384 and let Ω \Omega be a smooth embedded paper Moebius band of aspect ratio less than 3 + ϵ \sqrt{3}+\epsilon . We prove that Ω \Omega is within Hausdorff distance 18 ​ ϵ 18\sqrt{\epsilon} of an equilateral triangle of perimeter 2 ​ 3 2\sqrt{3} .

arxiv-2504-03933.title: Language Models Are Implicitly Continuous
arxiv-2504-03933.creator: Samuele Marro, Davide Evangelista, X. Angelo Huang, Emanuele La Malfa, Michele Lombardi, Michael Wooldridge
arxiv-2504-03933.description: Abstract Language is typically modelled with discrete sequences. However, the most successful approaches to language modelling, namely neural networks, are continuous and smooth function approximators. In this work, we show that Transformer-based language models implicitly learn to represent sentences as continuous-time functions defined over a continuous input space.

arxiv-2505-10653.title: On the Evaluation of Engineering Artificial General Intelligence
arxiv-2505-10653.creator: Sandeep Neema, Susmit Jha, Adam Nagel, Ethan Lew, Chandrasekar Sureshkumar, Aleksa Gordic, Chase Shimmin, Hieu Nguygen, Paul Eremenko
arxiv-2505-10653.description: Abstract We discuss the challenges and propose a framework for evaluating engineering artificial general intelligence ( eAGI ) agents. We consider eAGI as a specialization of artificial general intelligence (AGI), deemed capable of addressing a broad range of problems in the engineering of physical systems and associated controllers.

arxiv-2511-20598.title: Emergent Superfluidity of Hard-Core Excitons in Single-Layer Breathing-Kagome Nb 3 Te x Cl 8-x
arxiv-2511-20598.creator: Mahtab A. Khan 1,2 and Michael N. Leuenberger 1,3
arxiv-2511-20598.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mahtab A. Khan 1,2 and Michael N. Leuenberger 1,3. We develop a microscopic theory of superfluidity for hard-core dark excitons on the triangular lattice by mapping the large- U U Bose–Hubbard model to an effective XXZ spin- 1 2 \tfrac{1}{2} Hamiltonian including virtual hopping processes. Within this framework, we identify the superfluid phase that emerges between the two Mott-insulating endpoints at fillings 0 and 1, and derive its mean-field structure via a canted-spin solution.

pmc-11369532.title: Comparison of Different Reverse Transcriptase–Polymerase Chain Reaction–Based Methods for Wastewater Surveillance of SARS-CoV-2: Exploratory Study
pmc-11369532.creator: Annika Länsivaara, Kirsi-Maarit Lehto, Rafiqul Hyder, Erja Sinikka Janhonen, Anssi Lipponen, Annamari Heikinheimo, Tarja Pitkänen, Sami Oikarinen, WastPan Study Group
pmc-11369532.description: BackgroundMany countries have applied the wastewater surveillance of the COVID-19 pandemic to their national public health monitoring measures. The most used methods for detecting SARS-CoV-2 in wastewater are quantitative reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) and reverse transcriptase–droplet digital polymerase chain reaction (RT-ddPCR). Previous comparison studies have produced conflicting results, thus more research on the subject is required.

pmc-11647423.title: Effectiveness of antipsychotic drug therapy for treating psychosis in people with epilepsy: A systematic review
pmc-11647423.creator: Aryan Arora, Priya Prakash, Laura Rizzo, Graham Blackman, Anthony S David, Jonathan P Rogers
pmc-11647423.description: Individuals with epilepsy are at risk of developing preictal, ictal, postictal and interictal psychoses. Antipsychotic drugs (APDs) are the main class of drugs used to treat psychosis and schizophrenia. The efficacy and safety of APDs as a treatment for epileptic psychosis is not well understood.

pmc-12432219.title: Increased frontal functional connectivity correlates with structural disconnection in the anterior corpus callosum in healthy older adults
pmc-12432219.creator: Hanna Braaß, Nadine Reiter, Winifried Backhaus, Paweł P Wróbel, Fanny Quandt, Robert Schulz, Christian Gerloff, Focko L Higgen
pmc-12432219.description: Cognitive aging is a heterogeneous process characterized by a varied decline in brain performance. While the neurophysiological basis of this decline remains poorly understood, age-related alterations in structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) have been implicated. Understanding the relationship between these changes is crucial for identifying early markers of cognitive impairment.

pmc-12693568.title: Beyond Iron: The Roles of CD71 in the Pathophysiology of Cancer—A Comprehensive Review
pmc-12693568.creator: Georgios S. Markopoulos, Yannis V. Simos, Konstantinos I. Tsamis, Konstantina Gartzonika, Dimitrios Peschos, Lampros Lakkas
pmc-12693568.description: CD71, also known as transferrin receptor 1 (TfR1), is a transmembrane glycoprotein essential for cellular iron uptake, a prerequisite for cell proliferation, differentiation, and survival. While its canonical role in iron metabolism is well documented, accumulating research highlights CD71’s broader involvement in oncogenic processes that extend far beyond iron regulation.

pmc-13068059.title: Innate immune sensing of dietary alcohol ignites inflammation to drive alcohol-related disease
pmc-13068059.creator: Yeonseo Jang, Hoeun Bae, SuHyeon Oh, Gyeongju Yu, Hyun Bae, Minh Quan Nguyen, Raghvendra Mall, Minjie Fu, Aritra Ghosh, Jihye Lee, Suhyun Kim, Seyun Shin, Nabukenya Mariam, Cheong Seok, Daesik Kim, SangJoon Lee, Si Ming Man, Rajendra Karki
pmc-13068059.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Alcohol consumption has short- and long-term impacts on physical and mental health. Although multiple host and environmental factors contribute to alcohol-related disease, the innate immune sensors that detect toxic signals from alcohol remain poorly defined. Here, we show that alcohol cooperates with sterile- or infection-induced interferon signaling to drive inflammatory cell death, cytokine release, and liver injury in humans and mice.

pmc-13133881.title: Diabetes Status Modifies the Association Between Carotid Plaque Burden and Retinal Microvascular Parameters
pmc-13133881.creator: Ming Yang, Xueru Cheng, Jiaxin Guan, Zixuan Zhou, Jialin Wang
pmc-13133881.description: PurposeCarotid plaque burden (CPB) is a key indicator of atherosclerosis, yet its relationship with ocular microcirculation in the context of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) remains poorly understood. This study aimed to examine the association between CPB and ocular vascular parameters, and to evaluate whether this relationship is modified by diabetic status.

pmc-13556729.creator: L-H Hsu, S-H Hsu, Y-H Huang, M-C Huang
pmc-13556729.description: BackgroundDelirium Tremens (DT) is a life-threatening complication of alcohol withdrawal, yet current identification relies on subjective scales. There is an urgent need for objective biomarkers to complement clinical assessments. We hypothesized that integrating serum Neurofilament light chain (NfL) and genetic data into machine learning models would enhance risk stratification.

uslaw-usc-t16-s758e4.title: 16 U.S.C. § 758e–4 — “Central, Western, and South Pacific Ocean area” defined
uslaw-usc-t16-s758e4.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s758e4.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 9A (Preservation Of Fishery Resources). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. As used in sections 758e to 758e–5 of this title, the term “Central, Western, and South Pacific Ocean” means that area of the Pacific Ocean between latitudes 30 degrees north to 30 degrees south and from longitudes 120 degrees east to 130 degrees west.
